message_event.content: The new sign-up flow drops a step. Worth a look before Friday.

gaps.detail: Peek has no keypairs at all. This probe derives sk = sha256("peek:probe:user:"+_id), which means the relay would hold a key Peek can mint for any user — no user consent, no key custody, no recovery. Real interop needs a genuine key story first.

Peek ids are opaque Convex ids, not UUIDs. Derived channel UUID 7b32200c-e4c0-4216-b79a-8490fc05e0bd from a hash. Two Peek deployments would derive the same UUID for different topics only if ids collide, but nothing ties this UUID to a channel Buzz already knows.
Peek topics have no visibility/private flag and no workspace scope; "open" is invented here.
"insight" has no Buzz equivalent on kind:9 and no registered kind. Dropped.
Peek stores ms; Nostr created_at is seconds. Sub-second ordering is lost, and Peek sorts by createdAt — two messages in the same second become order-ambiguous on the relay.
Peek's stable id (m_1753300200000_1) is discarded: a Nostr event id is the hash of its own content. Peek would need to store the returned event id to keep the two in sync.
